invariants.rationale: The method returns result, which should not be null after creation unless an exception was thrown.
The config parameter is used to create the table; it is likely required to be non-null.
The storageConf parameter is passed for table creation; it should be non-null.
The return type is HoodieTable, so result is expected to always be an instance of HoodieTable.
skipValidation is a boolean value, so it can only be true or false.
